1.w: By David; a well-written song. How blessed is the one whose rebellious acts are forgiven, whose sin is pardoned.

2.w: How blessed is the one whose wrongdoing the Lord does not punish, in whose spirit there is no deceit.

3.w: When I refused to confess my sin, my whole body wasted away, while I groaned in pain all day long.

4.w: For day and night you tormented me; you tried to destroy me in the intense heat of summer. (Selah)

5.w: Then I confessed my sin; I no longer covered up my wrongdoing. I said, “I will confess my rebellious acts to the Lord .” And then you forgave my sins. (Selah)

6.w: For this reason every one of your faithful followers should pray to you while there is a window of opportunity. Certainly when the surging water rises, it will not reach them.

7.w: You are my hiding place; you protect me from distress. You surround me with shouts of joy from those celebrating deliverance. (Selah)

8.w: I will instruct and teach you about how you should live. I will advise you as I look you in the eye.

9.w: Do not be like an unintelligent horse or mule, which will not obey you unless they are controlled by a bridle and bit.

10.w: An evil person suffers much pain, but the Lord ’s faithfulness overwhelms the one who trusts in him.

11.w: Rejoice in the Lord and be happy, you who are godly! Shout for joy, all you who are morally upright!
